region: Germany, owner-managed SMEs preparing a succession (proxy for the EU27 owner-managed micro/small market)

facts.what: Number of SMEs whose owners want to find a successor by the end of 2029
facts.value: 545,000 (about 109,000 a year); 114,000 could close each year, about 569,000 in total
facts.source: KfW Research press release, KfW SME Panel (more than 13,000 SMEs)

facts.what: Share of SME owners aged 55 or older, and share of SMEs considering closure
facts.value: 57% aged 55+ (up three points on the year before); about one in four SMEs considering closure

facts.what: Average and median sellers' asking price for successions 2025 to 2029
facts.value: average about EUR 499,000, median EUR 375,000 (KfW calls it sellers' expectations, not market prices)
facts.source: KfW Research January 2026 as reported by mybusinessfuture.com (secondary)
facts.note: Secondary report of the KfW note; original not read

facts.what: Average EBITDA multiple paid by company size
facts.value: about 3.9x at EUR 200k EBITDA; about 7.2x at EUR 10m EBITDA
facts.geography: Europe (848 advisory firms, mid-market EUR 1m to 200m revenue)

facts.what: Owners' price expectations and buyers' financing as hurdles
facts.value: 43% of owners start with inflated price expectations; 39% of prospective successors struggle to finance the takeover (DIHK Report 2019, as cited); KfW Nachfolge-Monitoring 2024: price agreement a major hurdle in about a third of cases
facts.source: IWW summaries of DIHK and KfW reports

facts.what: How long the sales phase of a succession takes
How owners plan to hand over
facts.value: family 51.7%, external third-party sale 27.6% (Creditreform Austria); one survey: a quarter would sell to management, 2% to a financial investor; DIHK 2025 reported external successions at 48%
facts.source: Creditreform Austria press release; unternehmeredition.de; zwp-online summary of DIHK Report 2025
facts.note: Mixed countries, surveys differ in wording and size; used as a range

facts.value: many owners reluctant mainly because of the investors' reputation; an older TEC survey (2007): about 40% feared loss of influence; concern for the workforce is growing
facts.note: Old and partly commentary; treat as an assumption of direction, not a rate

facts.value: nexxt-change: free anonymous listings; 22,300 matches started since 2006 (site claim)

facts.what: Commission view on EU succession problem and cross-border transfers
facts.value: owners near retirement without a successor; June 2026 Recommendation asks Member States to ease cross-border transfers and build matchmaking platforms

gaps: No EU27 count of micro enterprises with a viable owner-exit (Eurostat says 33.1m enterprises, 99% micro or small, but no micro-only row was read)
No German or EU figure for the share of owners who would sell to a permanent non-EU holding company
No source for how many targets have EBITDA above EUR 100k, or for sector splits
No source for acceptance of earn-outs or seller notes in micro deals
No evidence on how EU sellers react to a Belize holding company
